about_the_game:
Dominate the skies with this unique offer!

The Antonov M Masha Soviet Tier IX fighter boasts excellent speed and maneuverability, while its four 23 mm autocannons can shred enemies to pieces in the blink of an eye. With its stunning design, speed, firepower, and agility, this aircraft will always be in the spotlight!

A hand-picked set of Ultimate equipment will boost this warbird's performance even further, while a unique decoration set (paint scheme, nose art, emblem) will make this beauty even more dazzling and commemorate its heritage.

Trident Strike DLC Content:

  • Antonov M Masha, a Soviet Tier IX fighter

  • Hangar slot for your new warbird.

  • Highly trained pilot with 6 free skill points for the Antonov M Masha

  • Ultimate Gyroscopic Sight

  • Ultimate High-Speed Gas Turbine

  • Ultimate Uprated Engine

  • Decoration set (paint scheme, nose art, emblem) for the Antonov M Masha, providing additional bonuses in battle: +5% to aircraft XP, +7% to crew XP.

Note: if you already have the Antonov M Masha on your account, you will be compensated with 5,550 gold after purchasing this DLC.
